title: English model setup: bounded ready-pointer publication
scope: Only replace the technical publication and resolution mechanism for the already-approved English installer. Preserve the consent/lease, UI/IPC states, exact download and digest pins, prior model support, no VI change, and true Windows product verification gates.
reason: Native directory rename can fail while payload descendant handles are open. Closing them before renaming leaves an avoidable race; persistent owner-denying ACLs can strand data after a forced job or host exit. Atomically publish an exact pointer file instead, while stable directory guards and all data guards stay open.

layout.legacy: live-translate/models/zipformer directory, allowed only when the pointer is absent and the exact pinned regular asset names/lengths/digests verify. Never replace or write a valid pre-existing legacy install.
layout.ready_pointer: live-translate/models/zipformer.current, one ordinary fixed-size file with strict ASCII body 'SIG4A-EN-1 ' plus exactly 32 lower-case hex GUID chars plus LF (44 bytes), no CR/BOM/extra bytes/path/user metadata.
layout.immutable_payload: live-translate/models/.sig4a-en-<same lower-case GUID>/payload containing exactly the five pinned regular files. GUID is application-generated, and the relative fixed names come from code, never free-form pointer data. Private protected-parent staging is ordinary owner-writable, not a permanent WRITE_DAC deny.
layout.unpublished_metadata: The operation-specific directory may contain an app-owned incomplete journal, archive.part and marker.part during setup. None is discoverable through passive status/model resolution; no model is Ready until a verified pointer exists. No added process arguments or commands grant permission to supply paths.

transaction: No file/network access before valid install start grant. Verifier is explicit, offline, and read-only. Existing valid target verifies without a network request. Existing malformed pointer, conflicting legacy slot, damaged/unrecognized target or reparse point fails closed; no fallback to legacy if a pointer is physically present, even unreadable or malformed.

Hold the existing package-local exclusive lease across manual and GUI install, actual capture modes and explicit verification. Keep verified stable local root/ancestor, models, operation directory and payload object handles non-delete-share, with verified identities/path ancestry and no UNC or reparse point. All newly created stage objects inherit a specific ordinary current-owner/SYSTEM ACL to limit other accounts, without irreversible owner-rights restrictions.

Download/verify/extract only exact code-pinned asset as already agreed, from one allowed redirect and before any parser. Create canonical payload files via CreateNew under anchored paths, verify every published filename/type/identity/size/hash. Retain all opened read guards without write/delete sharing across the pointer publish and Ready checks.

Create marker.part by exact handle with DELETE access and no write/delete sharing, flush exact pointer bytes on the same handle, recheck cancellation, all guarded directory identities and no legacy/pointer target under package lease. Use Win64 SetFileInformationByHandle(FileRenameInfo), ReplaceIfExists=false, on that original marker handle, with fixed basename zipformer.current relative to the stable models parent. No directory rename, no close/reopen of source marker, no overwrite, no POSIX replacement or path fallback. Check resulting exact marker ID/name and payload membership/identities/hashes through the retained guards before Ready. If an out-of-process filesystem edit creates a conflict around publication, do not acknowledge Ready and remove only our exact owned marker if it is still pinned, never the competing data.

On future explicit Start, Audio Check sample, or Verify, hold the same lease and stable guards while reading the fixed marker and verifying all pinned payload bytes before passing paths to the local Sherpa loader. Shape or mere presence can display Verify existing, never Ready. No automatically downloaded or upgraded model; Start remains explicit after verified setup.
cancellation_and_recovery: Cancellation/lease loss before commit requests stop and tears down the installer; terminal cancelled is sent only after clean exact-owned cancellation. Once guarded pointer rename wins, only the fully verified payload can commit; model readiness is re-verified on the next explicit visit/verify if the renderer or process already disappeared.

Mark the uniquely opened download archive delete-on-close (bounded process loss cleanup). For staged payload/marker paths, track exact object IDs from CREATE_NEW in an owned-only bounded local journal while in flight (no user identity/content). Under the same lease a later explicit install attempt may verify a documented, strict orphan identity and reclaim only recognized files with matching IDs via exact no-follow handles. Never recurse, glob-delete, trust an arbitrary marker location, auto-clean on startup, or delete a current/legacy target or an unexplained tree. If journal/directory/entry ownership, identity or shape cannot be proven, leave it untouched and surface cleanup_incomplete/actionable manual location rather than lose unrelated data.

Ordinary same-account software races are addressed by locks, stable guard handles, and exact file identity/digest checks. Deliberate tampering by a user/process that can modify the application binaries or model artifacts while the app is not holding handles is not a separate OS sandbox boundary; loader still rejects changed bytes and never follows a malicious path. No elevation or permanently inaccessible staging ACL.
required_windows_fixtures: Ordinary real NTFS publish succeeds with every payload handle still held deny-write/delete and all ancestor/stage/payload directory objects pinned. Verify RootDirectory-relative Win64 buffer, successful target exact marker ID and permitted filename plus actual local inference.

Second process exercises benign live prepublish ancestor/payload rename/replace and payload file write/delete while guards are held. Attempt competing marker create; no overwrite or opening arbitrary source on error. Attempt legacy slot creation, and show conflict cannot yield Ready or replace either foreign target.

Forced job kill before pointer publication and after exact publish: verify no corrupt/partial Ready, deletion side effects absent in unrelated sibling/foreign temp or valid legacy, and retry behavior/owned-only orphan handling. Cancellation during download/extract/precommit, existing empty/damaged or readonly path, malformed/oversize/reparse marker, reparse-backed payload, changed bytes and exhausted quota fail closed.

Actual extracted preview Windows UI install from deliberate user action, genuine pinned official bytes, zero request/side-effect counters first on decline/stale heartbeat, then digest-verified committed model and known synthetic Windows captions. This is not physical-device/60-minute or translation accuracy proof. Preserve earlier benchmark/existing regular Audio Check and locked suite gates.

gate.rule: Independent Advisor must approve the exact addendum and immutable implementation before acceptance. No weaker directory-rename/ACL fallback. No code-pass or Windows test claim here.
